# Habit & Sleep Tracker

[![Android CI](https://github.com/ak2303004/Habit-sleep-tracker/actions/workflows/build.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/ak2303004/Habit-sleep-tracker/actions/workflows/build.yml)

## 📱 Features

- ✅ Track daily habits with a tap
- 🌙 Log sleep hours and quality
- 📊 Beautiful dashboard with charts
- 💾 Export/Import data as JSON
- 🔒 All data stored locally
